paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -2.96% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (-1.95%) and Hang Seng weakest (-4.20%). Brent crude changed -2.49% to 90.45. Gold changed -5.90% to 3,764.3. Bitcoin changed -6.25% to 63,986.8281. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.103%, a relative move of +2.41%. Among the firms tracked, Jefferies (-10.72%) and Vale (-10.02%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: FirstFT: Anthropic IPO set to redraw venture capital’s power rankings (FT World).
